why: Used only to check the SFN College Score against published opinion. No rank in this file is an input to our score, which is computed from the College Scorecard alone. The lists were chosen because they disagree with each other: Washington Monthly ranks social mobility and public service, Times Higher Education ranks research and reputation. A score that tracks both is measuring something real; a score that tracks neither is measuring an artifact of its own weights.
